items.text:
Spent some time flying around and scrapping derelics, making some cash, but it kinda fell flat quick.

If you are the type that is great at setting your own goals in a game, like building a specific kind of ship for the heck of it, it may last a bit longer, but once I had my start hull polished up and expanded on a bit, the game was out of steam for me.

Not much scavenging for good parts, as you can fix up everything pretty quickly.

Combat may add a difference facette to it, once it's out, not sure it's a facette I'd enjoy though.

I kinda hoped it'd be a more sim-y Shipbreaker, maybe, plus some surival and economy elements but nah.
items.text_zh:
花了一些时间四处飞行、拆解废弃飞船，赚了点钱，但很快就有点索然无味了。

如果你是那种擅长在游戏里自己设定目标的人，比如为了好玩而建造某种特定类型的飞船，那它可能能多撑一段时间，但等我把初始船体打磨好并稍微扩建之后，这游戏对我来说就没劲了。

没什么好搜刮的，因为好东西你很快就能全修好。

战斗等推出后可能会给它增添一个不同的侧面，不过我不确定那会是我喜欢的侧面。

我本来有点希望它会是一款更偏模拟向的《Shipbreaker》，也许再加上一些生存和经济元素，但并没有。
